# PR Evidence

When preparing a pull request, report only evidence relevant to the changed
files. Use one or more of the recognised headings when applicable:

- CLI Contract
- Persistence Providers
- Backup / Restore
- HTTP / MCP
- Documentation

A concrete finding or `N/A — <reason>` is acceptable. Required CI provides
authoritative test results, so do not manually copy test counts into the PR.
AI review is advisory evidence only and never grants approval or merge authority.
